title: Hire and oversee the property manager
summary: Choose a manager, sign the management agreement and set the reporting and approval rules.
outlineSteps: Decide whether to self-manage or hire a manager
Write down the services the property needs
Budget the management fee at a market rate
Interview candidates on leasing, collections, maintenance and reporting
Check references and test the manager's market data
Set the reporting package and approval limits
Negotiate and sign the management agreement
Hand over records, accounts and keys
Review the manager's performance each year
